name: Google Document Table Mapping
description: Maps one parent child-table (e.g. items) to a {{marker}} in the template. Its columns are configured in the template's Column Mappings grid, tagged with the same marker.

fields.label: Child Table Fieldname
fields.description: Table fieldname on the source doc, e.g. items.

fields.label: Table Marker
fields.description: Marker paragraph in the template that is replaced by the rendered table, e.g. {{items_table}}.
